bullets.text: A 45-year-old man died by suicide in Eekadu near Tiruvallur due to alleged financier harassment, prompting a police complaint from his wife, and our office should monitor the investigation.
The Chennai Corporation identified 219 vulnerable flood-prone locations and plans to deploy 1,000 pumps for monsoon preparedness, and our office should track drainage work in Velachery.
The Greater Chennai Corporation finished desilting most of its stormwater drain network and plans to upgrade 780 damaged roads, and our office should watch road repair progress.
Birders spotted a pair of Terek sandpipers at the Pallikaranai marshland for the first time, raising the wetland bird tally to 205, and our office should note this environmental milestone.
Walgreens is setting up its first India Global Capability Center at DLF Downtown in Taramani, Chennai, and our office should support local tech sector growth.
